rationale: The agent did look up the user and orders, and even calculated a price difference, but it violated core policy requirements. It executed two exchange write actions and charged a stored payment method without first confirming with the user, which is explicitly disallowed. It also failed to provide the user the requested final amount due today; the only visible reply was a generic closing message with no totals or details. Additionally, there is inconsistency between the product looked up (4760268021) and the item used for the exchange (9844888101), with no confirmation of the exact 15-inch i7/8GB/1TB SSD SKU. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy and final information was not correctly communicated.
